solutions.title: Collect values, sort, and rebuild
solutions.strategy: Read every node value into a temporary list, sort the values, then create a new sorted chain.

timeComplexity.explanation: The temporary value list contains all m + n nodes, and sorting those values dominates the linear scans and rebuild.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The value list and rebuilt output chain both grow with the total number of input nodes.

solutions.title: Iterative pointer splice
solutions.strategy: Advance through both chains and attach the smaller current node to a dummy tail.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node from both input chains is inspected and linked once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The merge reuses existing nodes and keeps only a dummy node plus a tail pointer.
